fields.label: EPA
fields.help_text: The EPA the campaign was declared as evidence for. One record per covered EPA.

fields.label: MSF campaign
fields.help_text: The campaign this record is one face of. Sibling records share it and differ only by EPA.

fields.label: Feedback window closed
fields.help_text: The date the campaign closed to responses - when the evidence was complete.

fields.label: Supervision the reviewer judged this trainee to need
fields.help_text: Optional. Stated by the clinician who released the report, informed by the aggregate - never a mean of respondent scores, because a mean is not a rung.

fields.label: Reviewer's summary
fields.help_text: The narrative already released to the trainee. No respondent is named and no individual comment is reproduced here.
